That round is closed and GETFund has not yet published dates for the next foreign call; the call currently open on the portal is the 2026/27 local scholarship round (5 October - 27 November 2026).
official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 academic year (foreign round ran 13 April 2026 to 30 April 2026)

As of the verification date GETFund's live call is for 2026/27 Undergraduate and Postgraduate LOCAL scholarships (applications open 5 October 2026, closing 27 November 2026), and no new foreign round has been announced.

Financial support includes tuition fees, accommodation, and scholastic materials.' How to Apply page, Foreign Scholarship Coverage: 'Typically covers tuition, accommodation, and sometimes stipend for living expenses. Specific details regarding partial or full scholarship will be provided upon award.'
benefits: Financial, social, and academic support to Scholars
Financial support includes tuition fees, accommodation, and scholastic materials
Foreign coverage typically includes tuition, accommodation, and sometimes stipend for living expenses
eligibility: Must have obtained admission to undertake a Masters or Undergraduate-Medicine Only (Eastern Europe & Asia)
Must hold a first degree of at least second-class (for Master's applicants)
Must be available to start academic studies by the start of the academic year for which sponsorship is sought
Applicant must not be pursuing a PhD or Master's degree at the time of application
Should not be a previous beneficiary of a GETFund Foreign Scholarship applying for the same scholarship category
requirements: Admission Letter from accredited University (Unconditional & Financial Condition letters only)
Project or Research proposal (not exceeding 5 pages) (Masters and PhD Applicants)
documents: Admission Letter from accredited University (Unconditional & Financial Condition letters only)
Previous academic certificates and previous transcript (where applicable)
Project or Research proposal, not exceeding 5 pages (Masters and PhD applicants)
Curriculum Vitae, Academic Referees and Letter of Recommendation (occupational)
Passport Bio Page, Ghana Card, National Service certificate (where applicable) and Support Document from employer for Academic Leave (where applicable)
selection_criteria: Applications are vetted and shortlisted based on eligibility and documentation completeness
The selection process will be rigorous and transparent, with shortlisted candidates being contacted after a thorough review

Priority consideration for applicants pursuing STEM, TVET, special needs programmes, National Initiative Priority programmes, programmes at tuition-free Universities, lecturers of public Tertiary Institutions (via GTEC) and persons with special needs
coverage: Stipend for living expenses, described as sometimes provided
application_method: Visit the GETFund Website to access the scholarship Portal and complete an online application form
Create a profile, verify the account, fill the application form and upload required documents for vetting and shortlisting
Review the application summary and submit before the published closing date
official.application_route: Online only via the official GETFund Scholarship Portal at scholarships.getfund.gov.gh (also reached from www.getfund.gov.gh/scholarship-apply); applications sent through any other channel will not be processed
official.citizenship_residency: Applicant must be a Ghanaian; the basic requirement is being a Ghanaian Citizen
official.international_eligibility: No - only Ghanaian citizens are eligible; the award funds study at internationally accredited universities abroad
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No subject restriction, but priority consideration is given to STEM, TVET, special needs programmes, National Initiative Priority programmes, programmes at tuition-free Universities, lecturers of public Tertiary Institutions via GTEC, and persons with special needs
official.research_requirement: A project or research proposal not exceeding 5 pages is required from Masters and PhD applicants
official.duration: Valid for the postgraduate program duration as specified in the admission letter, subject to satisfactory academic performance; no deferment is allowed and the scholarship must be used for the academic year awarded
official.description: The Ghana Education Trust Fund's Postgraduate Foreign Scholarship provides Ghanaian graduates with opportunities to pursue advanced studies in reputable institutions abroad, building capacity in critical sectors with globally competitive knowledge and skills. GETFund states the programme delivers financial, social and academic support, with financial support covering tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials, and gives priority to STEM programmes and female education. Applications are accepted only through the official GETFund scholarship portal during the annual call.
official.region: Africa (Ghana) - funds study at accredited institutions abroad

applicant_utility.summary: This is a Ghanaian-government award that funds Master's study abroad, but it opens in short annual windows - the 2026/2027 foreign round ran only 13 to 30 April 2026 and has closed, and the call currently open on GETFund's portal is for local scholarships closing 27 November 2026. You must already hold an admission letter from an accredited, globally recognised university before you can apply, because an application without one goes no further. GETFund has not published any stipend figure and says partial-versus-full details follow the award, so build your budget around the published promise of tuition, accommodation and scholastic materials rather than a guaranteed cash amount.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Ghanaian first-degree holders with at least a second-class degree who already hold a Master's admission abroad, especially in STEM or TVET, plus public tertiary institution lecturers routed through GTEC.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure an unconditional or financial-condition admission letter plus the university fee schedule before the window opens, since conditional academic offers are not accepted
Draft a project or research proposal of no more than five pages, which Masters and PhD applicants must upload
Scan every document at full legibility - invisible or unclear uploads are an explicit disqualifier
Create and verify your portal account early so email and SMS verification do not eat into a window that has historically lasted under three weeks
Confirm you have never held a GETFund foreign award in the same category, because previous beneficiaries of that category cannot reapply
common_rejection_risks: Applying without an admission letter, or omitting the financial details and fee schedule
Multiple applications from one applicant, which is an instant disqualification
Being a previous GETFund foreign-scholarship beneficiary in the same category
Already enrolled on a Master's or PhD programme at the time of application
Missing the closing date inside a very short window
Holding another Ghana government agency scholarship at the same time
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Because GETFund publishes no amount, assume you self-fund anything outside the stated coverage: university application and acceptance fees, English or admission tests, visa and biometric fees, flights, health insurance, local transport, a thesis or fieldwork budget, and any living shortfall if the eventual award letter covers tuition and accommodation but only sometimes a stipend.
document_audit: The admission letter must be unconditional or financial-condition only; a conditional academic offer will fail vetting
The fee schedule must be issued by the university - a personal estimate is not a substitute
The research proposal has a hard five-page ceiling for Masters and PhD applicants
Ghana Card, passport bio page and National Service certificate are identity documents that stall vetting if blurred or cropped
Lecturers need the GTEC route plus an employer academic-leave letter, while other applicants need the occupational recommendation
alerts: The window is very short - the last foreign round lasted about seventeen days - so have the admission letter and scans ready in advance
Nothing can be edited once submitted; the portal locks the application, so review the summary line by line first
No deferment is allowed - the award must be used in the academic year it is granted
The announced 2026/27 call covers local scholarships only, so do not assume the foreign round is open
You may apply to other agencies, but you cannot hold two Ghana government scholarships simultaneously
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Create a profile on scholarships.getfund.gov.gh, verify the account by email or SMS, complete the form and upload all documents, review the summary, then submit before the closing date; vetting and shortlisting follow and shortlisted candidates are contacted.
